name: v0.3.17
body:
## Changes

### ✨ Features
- Add CPU architecture (x64/arm64) distinction across the entire stack for independent variant installations
- Database migration for architecture column with automatic legacy entry migration
- Architecture-aware installation paths ({build}_{backend}_{arch})
- Architecture badges and filters in Catalog and Dashboard UI

### 🐛 Fixes
- Composite keys now include architecture (build|backend|arch) to prevent variant conflicts
- Download status and progress tracking now architecture-aware
- Installation verification now checks architecture-specific variants
